---
title: "Blogometrics: Top Economic Bloggers by Scholarly Impact"
date: "2010-01-08"
categories: ["Economics"]
---

An article in the [Eastern Economics Journal](http://www.palgrave-journals.com/eej/journal/v36/n1/full/eej200946a.html "Eastern Economics Journal") ranks economics bloggers according to their scholarly impact.  This blog is [ranked](http://www.palgrave-journals.com/eej/journal/v36/n1/fig_tab/eej200946t1.html#figure-title "ranked") 78th.
